paragraphs: Praesidium states a mission to prevent the sexual abuse of children and vulnerable adults and to preserve trust in respected organizations. The Praesidium Safety Equation is described as a framework of eight organizational operations that allows an organization to identify where abuse could occur.

Screening and selection is presented as more than background checks, since the page states that very few offenders have criminal records. Training is described as giving employees and volunteers the information and skills they need to keep those in their care safe. Monitoring and supervision covers supervising employees and volunteers, supervising youth, monitoring high-risk activities, and monitoring architectural or facility risks.
The page claims more than 30 years of work by its experts on preventing sexual abuse.

quote.text: Our services are the most scientifically advanced tools in the business for preventing sexual abuse in organizations.
